# Agent Skills for Declarative Workflows

This directory contains structured information to help AI agents quickly find and understand documentation for declarative workflows in the Microsoft Agent Framework.

## Purpose

These skills files provide:
- Quick navigation to relevant documentation
- Structured metadata for agent discovery
- Topic mappings for common questions
- Examples and use cases

## Skills Available

1. **[workflow-documentation-guide.md](./workflow-documentation-guide.md)** - Complete navigation guide for declarative workflow documentation
2. **[workflow-quick-reference.md](./workflow-quick-reference.md)** - Quick reference for common tasks
3. **[workflow-topics-index.md](./workflow-topics-index.md)** - Comprehensive topic index with file mappings

## How Agents Should Use These Skills

### For Finding Documentation
1. Start with `workflow-documentation-guide.md` to understand the documentation structure
2. Use `workflow-quick-reference.md` for common questions
3. Consult `workflow-topics-index.md` for specific topics

### For Understanding Workflows
1. Read the overview section in the guide
2. Follow the learning path recommendations
3. Use the quick reference for syntax lookups

### For Implementation
1. Check the topics index for relevant sections
2. Reference the file paths provided
3. Follow cross-references between documents

## Documentation Location

All declarative workflow documentation is in: `docs/declarative-workflows/`
